rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the single fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Page 1 amounts split into the 12-slot peso comb and the 2-slot centavo comb of their row; page 2 prints the writer's official text in single cells. The ATC column of Items 13-15 is preprinted. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option. Parts III and the signatory/tax-agent cells are not joined: the official page keeps them disabled and empty. When Part V uses the Add More popup, row 5 prints OTHERS and the popup rows go on an attached sheet, as on the official printout.
